lemma norm_eq_of_algEquiv [Ring T] [Algebra R T] (e : S ≃ₐ[R] T) (x) :
    Algebra.norm R (e x) = Algebra.norm R x := by
  simp_rw [Algebra.norm_apply, ← LinearMap.det_conj _ e.toLinearEquiv]; congr; ext; simp
